question: Does comparing candidate-predicted and observer joint loads over the same causal filtering window improve model consistency and current contact discrimination?
scope: Existing-log diagnostic only. No live LQR/observer/feedforward/preparation change, threshold optimization, candidate reranking, new trajectory/physics episode, or automatic estimator adoption.
prior_inspection: All three original histories and I60-I63 errors are already known. This is retrospective internal comparison, not unseen validation.
original_campaign: I-58 native gain-scheduled LQR Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight; initial common shaft -1.0,+0.3,+0.9 rad, yaw 45 deg, command caps [1.5,0.6,0.6 N m,0.3,0.3 m/s]. Existing exact 5 ms state and prior applied input used by I-60/I-61.
primary_mask: 1 <= time_s < 41, total truth normal load >=1 N, unique dominant family >=90% total load; fixed I-61 eligible mask. Dominant support is not strict single contact.
point_mask: Primary mask AND finite N point, finite A point (accepted proposal else N), and finite truth equivalent point. Fixed for every parameter and policy; never restrict distance metrics to retained proposals. Unaccepted raw proposals do not exclude a valid native fallback. Distances in mm to truth equivalent point.
information_boundary: Kinematic maps use saved exact simulated q, frozen I61 points/families and known model. Loads are raw interval_mean and filtered observer generalized vectors. No solver contacts, true force, true family/history, terrain or future data enter inference. Solved truth is evaluation only.

endpoint_maps.HF: J_point(q_t,p_F_t,family_F_t)[:,6:9].T using original I61 physical proposal point/family; no new best-candidate selection.
endpoint_maps.HNalt: Same map for original I61 best physical candidate within native family. Primary paired current alternative.
endpoint_maps.HNeq: Same map assigned to native family at original native equivalent point; arbitrary virtual point allowed, with separate physical-band flag. Used for native fallback/anchor history, not confused with physical Nalt.
endpoint_maps.HA: Frozen I60 accepted? HF : HNeq. This is an offline causal shadow path on native-controller motion, not the historically actuated contact routing.
endpoint_maps.validity: Invalid point, family, pose or map explicit. An invalid alternative branch never resets a valid committed path.

interval_geometry_assumption: Hold current endpoint H over preceding5ms for each raw interval prediction. This is causal retrodiction available at interval end, not prediction made at interval start. Rolling contacts may migrate within the interval; no midpoint or half-interval contact-switch assumption is added. Exact HF-force covariance is unavailable from these snapshots.

observer_recurrence.frames: Raw force/world and moment/world use original observer midpoint-frame convention; last3 joint scalar torques remain in joint coordinates. Only last3 are scoring components.
observer_recurrence.verification: Reconstruct filtered9 from same initial observed gamma0 and raw means using the identical operation order, then compare all9 channels. First3 force rows of a point prediction reproduce total force by construction, not independent model evidence.

history_rules.initialization: At first valid committed-path state seed predicted joint history once from measured filtered gamma_joint. Ignore that seed interval for model scoring.
history_rules.seed_memory: 20 time constants, exp(-20). Track exact elapsed valid history/seed weight, do not treat initialization as model agreement.
history_rules.invalid: Invalid committed H, raw interval force, required observed state or nonadjacent time breaks the history. A gap row is unscorable; next adjacent valid row reseeds once, then requires another200ms contiguous history. Never zero-fill or carry across invalid intervals.
history_rules.counterfactual: At current t use the COMMITTED predicted history from t-1 plus current HF or HNalt raw-force increment. After scoring commit HA for A history or HNeq for N history, regardless of scores/vetoes. Never overwrite the past with todays family, and never let a new diagnostic decision change the anchor path.
history_rules.alternative_missing: A missing HF/HNalt branch only makes that branch/pair unknown; anchor updates continue if its own HA/HNeq is valid.
history_rules.observation_valid: All9 raw and filtered observer components finite, norm(FILTERED_F)>=1N, finite strictly increasing timestamps; low observed load also breaks the history and restarts200mswarmup. Observer recurrence verification itself still covers all finite channels, without this scoring load floor.
history_rules.decomposition: For each branch check eM2=lambda*(observed_gamma_joint_prev-predicted_anchor_prev)+alpha*(raw_interval_joint-Hbranch*raw_interval_F). Report inherited/current terms, normshares and cancellation. Current alternative validity does not reset committed path.

models.M0: Original instantaneous Hcurrent*FILTERED_F_t compared with filtered_gamma_joint_t; old I61 control.
models.M1: Same Hcurrent*RAW_interval_F_t compared with raw_interval_joint_t; endpoint interval approximation, no extra filtering.
models.M2: Primary matched history. raw_prediction_c=Hc_t*RAW_interval_F_t; filtered_branch_c=predA_prev+alpha*(raw_prediction_c-predA_prev); compare with filtered_gamma_joint_t. Commit frozen HA separately.
models.M3: Identical current branch calculation with native-equivalent committed prior, sensitivity control only; never selected as preferred method after outcomes.
models.identity_control: Observed-prior one-step branch uses observed_gamma_joint_prev+alpha*(Hcurrent*RAW_interval_F_t-observed_gamma_joint_prev). Its residual must equal alpha*M1 residual; smaller magnitude here is algebraic rescaling, not historical inference or improved detection.

normalization: Keep old .03 Nm + .10 R*norm(FILTERED_F) as identical fixed scale for every model score/gate. Retain raw Nm vectors. Do not change scale to raw force in M1/M2.

diagnostic_groups.primary: All original primary states and all6902 accepted proposals; unknown rows remain counted.
diagnostic_groups.family_correct: Current accepted I60 F proposal has dominant truth family (known6884 of6902); family correctness is necessary, not proof point/load model is exact.
diagnostic_groups.history_family_correct: Evaluation-only secondary subset: every A family matches a valid dominant truth family over previous50ms including current sample. Never used for history initialization or inference.
diagnostic_groups.useful: Native wrong, accepted proposal correct (294 knownframes).
diagnostic_groups.harmful: Native correct, accepted proposal wrong (6 knownframes).
diagnostic_groups.accepted_wrong: All18 accepted wrong proposals, including12 where native also wrong.
diagnostic_groups.point_outliers: All A point errors above native pooled maximum, plus per-phase maxima and the old99 useful-witness set.
diagnostic_groups.contact_qualification: Dominant>=90% allows weaker contributors; sampled last-substep truth does not identify actual5ms force/contact history.

model_consistency_qualification.primary_contrast: M2 vs M0 on SAME paired finite warmed current-family-correct accepted frames. Filtering M1 noise is not an independent success criterion.
model_consistency_qualification.critical_events: Every6 harmful,18accepted-wrong and pooled unsafe-point row must be scorable for a qualified positive conclusion. Report unknown coverage separately even if gate fails.
model_consistency_qualification.secondary: Per-joint RMS, maxabs residual percentiles, compatibility at unchanged tolerance, inherited-history term and current-increment decomposition, raw-to-filtered residual identity; report full unknown/fallback counts.
model_consistency_qualification.coverage_definition: Require paired M0_F_valid AND warmed M2_F_valid, not merely finite prediction or seed residual. Critical-event scorable gate uses F branch; paired-discrimination unknown Nalt is separately reported and counts incorrect in full denominators.

current_branch_discrimination.alternative: HF vs HNalt from same prior for M2/M3; point alternatives frozen. N_eq is separate virtual anchor.
current_branch_discrimination.correct: Useful group prefers F; harmful group prefers Nalt. Other12 accepted-wrong may have neither candidate correct. Ties/unknowns are reported and count as not correctly discriminated on full group denominators.
current_branch_discrimination.promising_criterion: M2 correctly prefers Nalt on at least3of6 harmful and F on at least90%of294 useful; neither correct count decreases vsM0, and at least one current-branch decision improves. IfM0 already correctly ranks all6harmful, retain all6 and improve useful decisions. This is retrospective diagnostic promise, not deployment qualification.
current_branch_discrimination.count_comparison: Correct counts must not decrease in either H or U, and their combined correct count must strictly increase. Mere row swaps with unchanged counts do not qualify. If M0 already has all6H correct, retain6 and increase useful correct count.

shadow_policy_control.gate: Apply unchanged .03+.10R*norm(FILTERED_F) component bound to current F residual for each model; accepted proposal passes else native fallback. Unknown warmed-history score retains A (no extra veto) with explicit unknown counter; invalid current F maps retain original unknown semantics.
shadow_policy_control.classification_and_points: All original primary states and fixed common finite point mask, including unknown/native fallbacks; no selection-only metric denominator.
shadow_policy_control.performance_gates: Report all unchanged I62 gates, separately from model-consistency and paired discrimination; no residual-only success claim.
shadow_policy_control.history: Even shadow-veto outcomes never change committed A/N history.
shadow_policy_control.unknown_precedence: Invalid current HF/map =>N fallback with original unknown semantics. Valid current HF but unavailable warmed history =>A (no extra veto). Never silently accept an invalid map or omit unknown rows.

events: Report frames and contiguous5ms eventclusters separately. Fixed +/-100ms windows around every harmful cluster, each phase worst A point, old7.875s useful example ifinprimary, and per-phasefirst useful. Future plotted observations are context only; all models causal.
acceptance_and_next: Complete model diagnostic regardless of outcome. No threshold tuning or live deployment in this iteration. Reduced model residual without improved discrimination does not establish a better contact estimator or explain trajectory drift. Any fresh episode/integration is future work with a separately frozen model.
replay: Preserve source/input hashes before new map/history arithmetic; all3 truth-blind feature packets sealed before labels evaluated. Portable cached H/raw/filtered/prior flags + NumPy replay, independent recurrence/history/ranking check. Record all corrections and version differences without replacing reported values.

numeric_verification.masks_counts_decisions: Exact except explicit1e-9dimensionless tie classification; report actual floating differences and any near-tie robust counts, never normalize values.

training_gates.pooled_family_errors_max: A errors on identical training states
training_gates.each_phase_harmful_count_max: A harmful count on same phase
